headline: About
paragraphs: I'm a Software Engineer II at Salesforce, Bengaluru, building backend systems for Tableau Licensing Services. My work spans licensing infrastructure, user services, and cloud migrations, with a focus on reliability and scale.

I'm drawn to hard problems: distributed systems, AI infrastructure, and the kind of engineering where getting it wrong has real consequences. Outside work, I build side projects and write about things I run into along the way.
